bio: Take a tour of the sights of Glasgow with this unique experience on board a 1966 Routemaster bus with Red Bus Bistro. This exciting twist on a city bus tour will include a delicious sparkling Afternoon Tea that you can enjoy on board, taking a seat at one of the retro style booth tables of this beautifully refurbished bus!  Enjoy the impressive sights and iconic landmarks as you sip a perfectly chilled glass of prosecco, passing by the likes of Provand’s Lordship, Glasgow University, Kelvingrove Art Gallery, Glasgow’s West End and much more!  Your savoury and sweet treat will include finger sandwiches, warm scones with clotted cream and preserves, an array of sweet cakes and pastries, accompanied by tea or coffee.
